item.title: StupidMirror 0.7.5
item.description:
• Claude Code opens the live phone in the Claude desktop app's Browser pane by itself, beside the conversation, the way Codex shows its panel in the chat. This now also works on installs that refuse launch configurations holding only a URL, such as Claude Desktop routed through a gateway: open_viewer returns a complete .claude/launch.json entry that starts the app's helper as a small placeholder page on port 17374, and Claude then sends the pane to the viewer link. The Claude plugin (0.1.5) replaces the older URL-only entry.
  • The website puts Codex and Claude Code side by side: a new section shows where the phone appears in each, and the MCP guide is now a Claude Code guide.
